items.statement: Independently define and preserve the supplied molecular objects, explore/deduplicate arrangements, and document stationary-point validation, coverage and stopping.
items.expected: Candidate identities, counts, advancement and stopping are reported. Covalent rearrangement is not mistaken for validated noncovalent association merely because frequencies are real; bounded failure remains explicit.

items.statement: The binary Tb·Pa interaction energy is required, with explicit model correspondence and limitations.
items.expected: Report the numerical control energy and reference/solvent convention. External numeric-source correspondence is not proven by an unspecified or different control model; the source Fig3e uses the label Hex-Tb-Pa.

items.statement: The defined observable is diamine association with the complete ion-pair–aldehyde host, not four-component total assembly.
items.expected: Report E(ion_pair.aldehyde.diamine)-E(ion_pair.aldehyde)-E(diamine), validated identities and explicit relaxed/frozen/BSSE conventions. Unresolved source conventions are limitations, not permission to pick a target-matching energy definition.
